ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity regions cover the majority of the fluke surface. High-intensity pixels are mapped as localized linear streaks (rake marks) across both lobes, with a specific high-intensity irregular patch located on the upper-mid region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with symmetric, well-defined linear boundaries and a sharp interior vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary with irregular pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a convex curvature that tapers into acute, upwardly hooked distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible as isolated, high-contrast circular white pixel clusters located on the extreme left distal tip and the lower central margin near the water surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, non-parallel high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the right lobe surface and 20% of the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-directional linear rake marks across both lobes and a small, distinct circular mark near the upper right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique high-contrast marking on the upper right lobe resembling a closed loop or the character 'P'.
